description_en: Queries the preprocessing and image slicing status of a sub-scene
description_zh: 子场景的预处理及切图状态
name: GetSubSceneTaskStatus

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authorization diagnosis details returned when a permission check fails, including the principal, action, policy, and reason for denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authorization action that triggered the permission denied error. You can use this action to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An authorized account administrator can decode the message to troubleshoot the denial reason
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denial reason, which distinguishes between lack of explicit authorization and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denial, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the task fails

ErrorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the task fails

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:
init: Not started.
processing: Processing.
failure: Failed.
succeed: Completed.
canceled: Canceled
Status.description_zh: 未开始  init 处理中   processing   失败     failure  完成     succeed  取消     canceled
Status.title_en: 未开始  init 处理中   processing   失败     failure  完成     succeed  取消     canceled
Status.title_zh: 未开始  init 处理中   processing   失败     failure  完成     succeed  取消     canceled

wall_line: Wall line prediction.
